CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Autumn-2024 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Autumn-2024 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 4,412 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 15 benchmark sites in 5 regions spanning 3 states (survey period: March 2024 to May 2024). These surveys captured 128 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 19 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 1,817 cards across 151 sites, with 6.5% showing evidence of mouse activity (119 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 551 transects across 150 sites (survey period: March 2024 to May 2024), detecting active burrows in 10.5% of transects (total: 121 active burrows).
